name: Sika AnchorFix-3001
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX®-3001: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix®-3001, April 2023, Version 04.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sika-anchorfix-3001.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix®-3001 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.05).
1.2 Product description. Sika AnchorFix®-3001 is an epoxy resin based, 2-part, thixotropic, 1:1 mixing ratio, high performance anchoring adhesive. It is specifically designed for anchoring threaded rods and reinforcement bars in both cracked and un-cracked dry or damp concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika AnchorFix®-3001 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Anchoring adhesive for fixing of non-expanding anchors in the following:
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Structural work.
    - Rebar / steel reinforcement anchoring in new and refurbishment works
    - Threaded rods
    - Bolts and special fastening / fixing systems
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Metalwork, carpentry.
    - Handrails, balustrades and supports
    - Railings
    - Window and door frames
1.6 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Substrates.
    - Concrete (cracked and un-cracked)
    - Hollow and solid masonry
    - Wood
    - Natural and reconstituted stone
    - Solid rock
1.7 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix®-3001
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: EPOXY HIGH PERFORMANCE CHEMICAL ANCHORING ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability.
    - Conformity with LEED v4 MRc 2 (Option 1): Building Product Disclosure and Optimization – Environmental Product Declarations
    - Conformity with LEED v4 MRc 4 (Option 2): Building Product Disclosure and Optimization - Material Ingredients
2.3 Approvals / certificates.
    - Complies to NCC 2019 reference to AS 5216:2018 - Design of post-installed and cast-in fastenings in concrete
    - Potable Water approved to AS4020:2018 - Testing of products for use in contact with drinking water.
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to ETA 14/0157, based on ETAG 001 Part 1 and Part 5 - Bonded injection type anchor for use in cracked and uncracked concrete for a service life of 50 and/or100 years
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to ETA 14/0368, based on ETAG 001 Part 1 and Part 5 - Post installed rebar connections
    - Adhesive Anchors for Cracked and Un-cracked Concrete IBC/IRC, Sika AnchorFix®-3001, ICC-ES, Evaluation report No. ESR-3608
    - Drinking Water System Components NSF/ANSI 61, Sika AnchorFix®-3001, IAPMO R&T, Certificate No. K- 8319
    - Fire Testing ISO 834-1, Sika AnchorFix®-3001, CSTB, Test report No. 26054326/B
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ETAG 001: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Characteristics / Advantages (p.1); Technical Information > Service temperature (p.2).
    - AS 5216:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - NCC 2019: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS4020:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETA 14/0157: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ETA 14/0368: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ISO 834-1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM D 695: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM D 790: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength in flexure (p.2).
    - ASTM D 638: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in tension (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Long open time
    - Can be used in damp concrete
    - High load capacity
    - ETA to ETAG 001 for anchoring in cracked concrete
    - ETA to ETAG 001 for rebar connections
    - ESR to AC308 by ICC-ES, anchoring in cracked concrete for static, wind and earthquake loading
    - Seismic tested (C1)
    - Suitable for contact with drinking water
    - Fire resistant
    - Styrene-free
    - Good adhesion to the substrate
    - Shrinkage-free hardening
    - Standard sealant guns can be used (250 ml cartridge)
    - Low wastage
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Epoxy
2.7 Colour.
    | Part A | off-white |
    | Part B | dark grey / black |
    | A+B mixed | grey |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Density.
    | A+B mixed | ~1.49 kg/l |
2.9 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: ~85 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: ~5 000 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~45 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 790)
    - Tensile strength: ~23 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Modulus of elasticity in tension: ~5 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
2.10 Service temperature.
    | Long term | -40 °C min. / +40 °C max. |
    | Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C |
    Test method printed: (ETAG 001, Part 5)
2.11 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sika AnchorFix® Flexible Extensions
    - Sika AnchorFix® Hole Cleaning Brushes-Steel
    - Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers -Nozzles
    - Sika AnchorFix® Straight Extensions
    - Sika AnchorFix® Perforated Sleeves
2.12 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10 °C and +25 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.13 Packaging.
    | 250 ml standard cartridge | 12 cartridges per box |
    | pallet: 75 boxes |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.05) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - Mortar and concrete must be at the required design strength.
    - Substrate tensile / compressive strengths (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must be confirmed by testing. The anchor hole must always be clean, free from oil and grease etc.
    - Loose particles must be removed from the holes. Threaded rods and rebar's must be cleaned thoroughly and free from dirt, oil, grease, corrosion products or any other substances and particles which could affect adhesion.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 04.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Part A : Part B = 1 : 1 by volume
    - Layer thickness: ~7 mm max
    - Sag flow: Non-sag, including overhead
4.3 Curing time.
    | Temperature | Open time - Tgel | Curing time - Tcur |
    | +40 °C | 3 minutes | 3 hours |
    | +35 °C to +40 °C | 4 minutes | 4 hours |
    | +30 °C to +35 °C | 6 minutes | 5 hours |
    | +25 °C to +30 °C | 8 minutes | 6 hours |
    | +20 °C to +25 °C | 11 minutes | 7 hours |
    | +15 °C to +20 °C | 15 minutes | 8 hours |
    | +10 °C to +15°C | 20 minutes | 12 hours |
    | +5 °C to +10 °C | —* | 24 hours |
    Note printed: * Minimum cartridge temperature: +10 °C
4.4 Mixing.
    - Preparing cartridge: 250 ml 1. Unscrew and remove the cap 2. Pull out the plug 3. Screw on the static mixer 4. Place the cartridge into the application gun ready for use Preparing cartridge: 400, 600 & 1500 ml 1.Unscrew the cap 2. Pull out the red plug 3. Screw on the static mixer 4. Place the cartridge into the application gun ready for use
    - When the work is interrupted the static mixer nozzle can remain on the cartridge after the gun pressure has been released. If the resin has hardened in the nozzle when work is resumed, a new nozzle must be attached.
4.5 Application method / tools.
    - Reference must be made to further documentation where applicable, such as relevant method statement, application manual and installation or working instructions.
    - Anchors in solid masonry/concrete 1. Drill hole with an electric drill to the diameter and depth required. Drill hole diameter must be in accordance with anchor size 2. The drill hole must be cleaned with oil free compressed air using an air lance, pressure: 6 Bar (90 psi). Start from the bottom of the hole and clean minimum 2x until return air stream is free of dust 3. The drill hole must be thoroughly cleaned with the special steel brush (at least 2x). The diameter of the brush must be larger than the diameter of the drill hole 4. The drill hole must be cleaned again as stage 2 5. The drill hole must be thoroughly cleaned again as stage 3 6. The drill hole must be cleaned again as stage 2 & 4 7. Pump gun at least 2x until both parts are extruded as a one consistent colour. Do not use this material. Release the gun pressure and clean the static mixer opening with a cloth 8. Inject the adhesive into the drill hole, starting from the bottom and slowly pull out the static mixer while extruding the resin into the hole. Avoid entrapping air. For deep holes use extension tubing 9. Insert the anchor with a rotary motion into the filled drill hole within the adhesive open time. Some of the adhesive must flow out of the hole 10. During the resin hardening time the anchor must not be moved or loaded
    - Important Note: Anchors in hollow blocks: Use Sika AnchorFix®-1.
4.6 Cleaning of equipment.
    - Clean all tools and application equipment with
    - Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Natural / reconstituted stone and solid rock properties vary particular with regard to strength, composition and porosity. For each application, the suitability of Sika AnchorFix®-3001 must be tested for bond strength, surface staining and discoloration by first applying the product to a sample area before full project application.
4.8 Further information.
    - For specific information on design refer to: Technical Documentation Sika AnchorFix®-3001 870 43 10
    - Sika Method Statement: Sika AnchorFix®
    - Sika AnchorFix®: Approvals

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 10 °C min. / +30 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.4 Dew point. Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least +3 °C above dew point.
5.5 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.6 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Natural / reconstituted stone and solid rock properties vary particular with regard to strength, composition and porosity. For each application, the suitability of Sika AnchorFix®-3001 must be tested for bond strength, surface staining and discoloration by first applying the product to a sample area before full project application.
5.7 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: ~85 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: ~5 000 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 695)
    - Tensile strength in flexure: ~45 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 790)
    - Tensile strength: ~23 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Modulus of elasticity in tension: ~5 500 N/mm²(7 days, +20 °C) (ASTM D 638)
    - Service temperature: Long term | -40 °C min. / +40 °C max.; Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C (ETAG 001, Part 5)
5.8 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.9 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix®-3001, April 2023, Version 04.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sika-anchorfix-3001.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika AnchorFix®-3001 Part A, version 13/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sds-sika-anchorfix-3001parta.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika Anchorfix-3001 Flyer, version 14/09/2021, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/Sika%20AU%20AnchorFix-3001%20-%20Flyer%20(1).pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
